description:
Title: Instruct an artist to create a 3D model print it on a 3D printer

When craving a custom 3D model, as a first step you have to instruct an artist to create a project for you.
First you have to send him several sketches, and then tell him what to change until you are satisfied with the result.
After that, you choose a plastic color you want to use for 3D printing.
If you have the color at home (in stock), you check how much color you have left.
If it's under 100 grams, you put it on your shopping list.
If you do not have the color at home, you order it.
When you have the plastic, you can turn the printer on and heat up the bed and the extruder (it continuously sends you back its status).
While doing that, you can generate the gcode file for your printer out of the STL sent to you by the artist.
After that you print the model.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_3DModel"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/3d-model">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Sketches" name="Sketches"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ChangeInstructions" name="Change instructions"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_STL" name="STL model"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PrinterStatus" name="Printer status"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_3DModel">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Artist" name="Artist" processRef="Process_Artist"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Printer" name="3D printer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Sketches" name="Send sketches" sourceRef="Task_SendSketches" targetRef="Start_ArtistSketches" messageRef="Message_Sketches"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ChangeInstructions" name="Send change instructions" sourceRef="Task_SendChanges" targetRef="Start_ArtistChanges" messageRef="Message_ChangeInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_InitialSTL" name="Send STL model" sourceRef="Task_SendInitialSTL" targetRef="Event_ReceiveSTL" messageRef="Message_STL"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RevisedSTL" name="Send revised STL model" sourceRef="Task_SendRevisedSTL" targetRef="Event_ReceiveSTL" messageRef="Message_STL"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PrinterStatus" name="Send printer status" sourceRef="Participant_Printer" targetRef="Boundary_PrinterStatus" messageRef="Message_PrinterStatus"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Instruct an artist and print a 3D model" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Craving" name="Crave a custom 3D model"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendSketches" name="Send sketches"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReceiveSTL" name="Receive STL model">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ReceiveSTL" messageRef="Message_STL"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReviewModel" name="Review the model"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Satisfied" name="Satisfied with the result?" default="Flow_NotSatisfied"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendChanges" name="Tell the artist what to change"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ChooseColor" name="Choose plastic color"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ColorAtHome" name="Is the color at home?" default="Flow_ColorNotAtHome"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckQuantity" name="Check how much color is left"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Under100" name="Under 100 grams?" default="Flow_AtLeast100g"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AddShoppingList" name="Put color on shopping list"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_WaitForListedPlastic" name="Wait until plastic is available">
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalEventDefinition_ListedPlastic">
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">plasticAvailable</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_OrderPlastic" name="Order plastic"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_WaitForOrderedPlastic" name="Wait until plastic is available">
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalEventDefinition_OrderedPlastic">
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">plasticAvailable</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PlasticReadyMerge" name="Plastic available"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationSplit" name="Prepare printing"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_TurnOnPrinter" name="Turn on the printer"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_HeatPrinter" name="Heat the bed and extruder"/>
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="Boundary_PrinterStatus" name="Printer status received" attachedToRef="Task_HeatPrinter" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_PrinterStatus" messageRef="Message_PrinterStatus"/>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_PrinterStatus" name="Printer status received"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_GenerateGCode" name="Generate G-code from the STL"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationJoin" name="Printing preparation complete"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PrintModel" name="Print the model"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Printing" name="Model printed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_01" sourceRef="Start_Craving" targetRef="Task_SendSketches"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_02" sourceRef="Task_SendSketches" targetRef="Event_ReceiveSTL"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_03" sourceRef="Event_ReceiveSTL" targetRef="Task_ReviewModel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_04" sourceRef="Task_ReviewModel" targetRef="Gateway_Satisfied"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Satisfied" name="Satisfied" sourceRef="Gateway_Satisfied" targetRef="Task_ChooseColor">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">satisfied</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotSatisfied" name="Not satisfied" sourceRef="Gateway_Satisfied" targetRef="Task_SendChanges"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ChangesToReceive" sourceRef="Task_SendChanges" targetRef="Event_ReceiveSTL"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_05" sourceRef="Task_ChooseColor" targetRef="Gateway_ColorAtHome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ColorAtHome" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ColorAtHome" targetRef="Task_CheckQuantity">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">colorAtHome</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ColorNotAtHome" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ColorAtHome" targetRef="Task_OrderPlastic"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckQuantity" sourceRef="Task_CheckQuantity" targetRef="Gateway_Under100"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Under100" name="Under 100 grams" sourceRef="Gateway_Under100" targetRef="Task_AddShoppingList">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">remainingGrams < 100</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AtLeast100g" name="100 grams or more" sourceRef="Gateway_Under100" targetRef="Gateway_PlasticReadyMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ListedPlasticWait" sourceRef="Task_AddShoppingList" targetRef="Event_WaitForListedPlastic"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ListedPlasticReady" sourceRef="Event_WaitForListedPlastic" targetRef="Gateway_PlasticReadyMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderPlasticWait" sourceRef="Task_OrderPlastic" targetRef="Event_WaitForOrderedPlastic"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderedPlasticReady" sourceRef="Event_WaitForOrderedPlastic" targetRef="Gateway_PlasticReadyMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PlasticToPreparation" sourceRef="Gateway_PlasticReadyMerge" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PreparationToPrinter" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_TurnOnPrinter"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TurnOnToHeat" sourceRef="Task_TurnOnPrinter" targetRef="Task_HeatPrinter"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HeatToJoin" sourceRef="Task_HeatPrinter" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PreparationToGCode" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_GenerateGCode"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GCodeToJoin" sourceRef="Task_GenerateGCode" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinToPrint" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin" targetRef="Task_PrintModel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrintToEnd" sourceRef="Task_PrintModel" targetRef="End_Printing"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StatusToEnd" sourceRef="Boundary_PrinterStatus" targetRef="End_PrinterStatus"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Artist" name="Create and revise the 3D model" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ArtistSketches" name="Sketches received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ArtistSketches" messageRef="Message_Sketches"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateModel" name="Create the 3D model"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendInitialSTL" name="Send STL model"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_InitialSTL" name="STL model sent"/>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ArtistChanges" name="Change instructions received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ArtistChanges" messageRef="Message_ChangeInstructions"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviseModel" name="Revise the 3D model"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRevisedSTL" name="Send revised STL model"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_RevisedSTL" name="Revised STL model sent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_01" sourceRef="Start_ArtistSketches" targetRef="Task_CreateModel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_02" sourceRef="Task_CreateModel" targetRef="Task_SendInitialSTL"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_03" sourceRef="Task_SendInitialSTL" targetRef="End_InitialSTL"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_04" sourceRef="Start_ArtistChanges" targetRef="Task_ReviseModel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_05" sourceRef="Task_ReviseModel" targetRef="Task_SendRevisedSTL"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_06" sourceRef="Task_SendRevisedSTL" targetRef="End_RevisedSTL"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
